blocks.text: Periodic table ko “Symbol of Chemistry” (chemistry ki pehchan) kehna bilkul theek hai. Yeh sirf ek saada chart nahi, balke chemistry ki maloomat ka ek bohat aham aur mukammal zariya hai. Agar elements ko is tarah tarteeb (arrangement) se na rakha jata to chemistry ke itne bare maidan ko samajhna mushkil hota. Periodic table ka banna science ki tareekh mein ek bara mor (turning point) tha, jis se bohat si nayi daryaftein (discoveries) huin. Aaj ke periodic table mein elements ko un ke atomic number, electronic configuration aur baar baar aane wali chemical properties ki buniyad par table ki shakal mein rakha gaya hai. Is se 118 elements aur un ki properties samajhne ki buniyad milti hai.

Sirf teen sau saal pehle insaan ko ek darjan (12) se bhi kam elements maloom the. 1700 A.D. tak sirf 12 elements pehchane gaye the: gold, silver, copper, iron, lead, tin, mercury, phosphorus, sulfur, carbon, zinc aur arsenic. Waqt ke saath aur elements daryaft (discover) hue, to scientists ne unhein ek nizam (system) se rakhne ki koshish ki. 18th century ke aakhir tak Antoine Lavoisier ne elements ko metals aur non-metals mein baantne ki koshish ki. 1829 mein Döbereiner ne milti-julti properties wale elements ko teen teen ke groups mein rakha jinhein triads kehte hain. Us ne dekha ke beech wale element ka atomic weight baqi do ke average ke qareeb hota hai. Misal: lithium, sodium aur potassium.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein triad “(⁷Li²,Na³,⁷K)” chhapa hai, jo ghalat hai. Sahi: ⁷Li, ²³Na, ³⁹K. Lithium ka atomic mass 7, sodium ka 23 aur potassium ka 39 hai; (7 + 39) ÷ 2 = 23, yani beech wale sodium ka mass baqi do ka average hai.

1864 mein English chemist John Newlands ne us waqt ke 62 maloom elements mein pehli baar periodicity (properties ka ek khaas waqfe ke baad dobara aana) dekhi. Jab elements ko barhte atomic mass ki tarteeb mein rakha gaya to har aathwen (8th) element ki properties pehle wale se milti thin. Is liye us ne elements ko aise groups mein rakha ke har aathwan element pehle element jaisa ho.

1869 mein Russian chemist Dmitri Mendeleev ne, jinhein periodic table ka baap (father) kaha jata hai, 63 elements ko barhte atomic mass ke mutabiq aath vertical (khare) columns mein rakha, aur milti-julti properties wale elements ek hi group mein aaye. Us ke table ki kamyabi ka raaz yeh tha ke us ne abhi tak na mile elements ke liye khali jagahein chhorin aur un ke atomic mass aur properties ki peshgoi (prediction) ki. Jab yeh elements baad mein mile to peshgoiyan sahi nikleen.

blocks.title: Dmitri Mendeleev
blocks.text: Mendeleev ne elements ko un ke atomic masses ke mutabiq tarteeb diya, aur us ka table elements ki classification (groups mein baantna) ki pehli sab se numayan (notable) koshish thi.
Usi saal (1869) Lothar Meyer ne elements ke atomic weights aur atomic volumes ka graph banaya. Un ke mashhoor curves ne bhi periodicity dikhai, yani properties ek waqfe ke baad dobara aati hain.

1913 mein Moseley ne X-ray emission ke zariye maloom elements ke theek theek atomic numbers nikale. Us ne elements ko atomic mass ke bajaye atomic number ki tarteeb mein rakha, jis se Mendeleev ke table ki ghaltiyan aur be-qaidgiyan (discrepancies) door ho gayin. Is bari kamyabi ke baad Moseley ne Periodic Law ko badal diya: elements ki properties un ke atomic numbers ke periodic functions hain (yani atomic number ke saath ek pattern mein dohrati hain).

blocks.prompt: Mendeleev ne apne table mein khali jagahein chhorin; Moseley ne baad mein table ko dobara tarteeb diya. Dono ne kya naya kiya, aur Moseley ki tabdeeli se ghaltiyan kyun door huin?
blocks.explanation: Mendeleev ki khali jagahon ne un elements ki peshgoi ki jo abhi mile nahi the, un ke mass aur properties samet; yeh peshgoiyan sahi nikleen, is liye table par bharosa barha. Lekin atomic mass ki tarteeb mein kuch elements ghalat jagah par the. Moseley ne X-ray emission se atomic numbers nikale aur elements ko atomic number se tarteeb diya, to Periodic Law atomic number par aa gaya aur yeh be-qaidgiyan khatam ho gayin.

items: Periodic table 118 elements ko atomic number, electronic configuration aur baar baar aane wali properties ke mutabiq rakhta hai.

Lavoisier (metals aur non-metals), Döbereiner (triads, 1829), Newlands (har aathwan element, 1864), Mendeleev (atomic mass se aath columns, khali jagahein, 1869), Meyer (atomic volume curves) aur Moseley (atomic numbers, 1913).
